**SculptForge runs natively on Wayland**
On Linux, every package (.deb, .rpm, AppImage, Flatpak, tar.gz) opens as a native Wayland window: no XWayland, sharp at 125%, 150% or 200% scaling, and pen pressure, tilt and the eraser through the Wayland tablet protocol. X11 sessions work the same, so RHEL and Rocky workstations are covered either way. No licence server, no account.
Guide: https://sculptforge.app/guide/installing.html
